entry.title: New: dsh-vision-opencode
entry.summary: Adds a configurable vision model to text-only main models: a vision_read_image tool, a composer-bar vision-model selector, and automatic image-to-text conversion for text-only routes. Exact install spec: github:poiuyjie/dsh-vision-opencode. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
